task: Publish the agreed 24-check v3 rubric with evidence-backed components, binary shipping and returns, and the documented frontend lookup IDs.
nonGoals: No frontend, production, Browser API or R2 collection, timeout, usage limits, or queue protocol changes. No live inference in CI. Keep frozen older reports.

outcomes.description: New reports expose seven groups and 24 stable check IDs, Structure /40, Content /60, evidence joins, and correct unresolved component subtotals.
outcomes.evidence: Synthetic and queue regression fixtures and contract tests.

outcomes.description: Shipping and returns are evidence-gated binary checks. Product JSON-LD presence replaces the old agent guide points. Historical rubric replay is preserved.
outcomes.evidence: Policy, parser and frozen report assertions.

outcomes.description: Replay the verified retained Faherty artifact locally and identify measured results and genuine coverage gaps.
outcomes.evidence: Native local Worker replay and sanitized evaluation handoff.

process.description: Use Terra agents, separate plan, independent review, and normal PR CI.
process.evidence: Git history, actual traces, review and hosted CI.

styleEfficiency.description: Reuse existing source observations and criterion scoring. Keep IDs deterministic and preserve established API envelope.
styleEfficiency.evidence: Reviewed diff and scoped regression tests.

exitTest.reason: Rubric scoring, validation and report serialization change no queue checkpoints, handoff or resume protocol.
